content.comment_body: Hello! I recently obtained a [product_name] module along with a [product_name] expansion module. 1) How do I connect a 4-20mA sensor to this setup? 2) Is it possible to use a second sensor (0-10V)? Thank you.
[product_name] has built-in analog inputs for 0-10V signals. For 0(4)-20mA sensors, you'll need an [product_name] expansion module. There is an example you can download at: [url]

You can use a 500 ohm resistor to transform a 4-20mA sensor signal into a 2-10V voltage. For 0 - 10V (or 2-10V) signals, wire them to specified analog input terminals (for example, AI1 or AI2) on the [product_name] module.
Hello [user_name], the link you provided ([url]) redirects to the main [company_name] introduction page. Do you know where the specific file can be found? Thank you!
Hello, the file location has changed. New link: [url]. This example is included in [url]. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants need clear instructions on how to connect different analog sensors (such as 4-20mA and 0-10V) to specific analog input terminals of [product_name] modules. There are limitations with the built-in analog inputs, making expansion modules necessary for certain sensor types. Changing and outdated documentation links have caused confusion and made it harder for users to find relevant examples. Ensuring proper sensor compatibility and module selection remains a key concern.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect concise and accurate information about wiring various sensor types to analog inputs, guidance on which expansion modules or adaptations are required, and reliable access to up-to-date documentation or configuration examples.
